subject: Gut Bacterial Metabolite Raises Alzheimer's Risk: A New Target for Intervention
script: From Agewell Brief: Gut Bacterial Metabolite Raises Alzheimer's Risk: A New Target for Intervention. A bacterial compound in the gut may increase Alzheimer's risk and accelerate cognitive decline, opening a new avenue for prevention. Alzheimer's disease remains one of the most feared and costly conditions of aging, with no cure and limited treatments. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
